digest.component_or_area: reconcile-bridge-canary workflow and canary monitoring logic
propositions: Reconcile-bridge-canary workflow contains ~200 lines of production logic in YAML run-blocks (staleness classification and two alert-ticket lifecycle state machines) that are untestable and unlintable.

Four distinct logic families (heartbeat classification, heartbeat alert lifecycle, binding drift detection, binding drift alert lifecycle) must be extracted to Python subcommands while preserving existing error handling dispositions and git-push CAS loops remain in YAML.

The extracted Python module must handle GitHub API queries, rebar CLI invocations, alert state transitions (find/open/comment/close), and drift JSON parsing with injected runner seam and DRY_RUN short-circuit defense.
Anti-rot tests must pin the thin YAML wiring to scripts/canary_bridge.py subcommands and verify both CAS push loops (bridge commit-back and canary flush) remain byte-identical and verbatim-tested.
